QuestInfo.name: [Dream Fragment] First Memory
QuestInfo.0: Somewhere in Lachelein Main Street there's a crack in the fabric of the dreamworld that is bothering you. It appears to to be a window into Lucid's subconscious mind.
QuestInfo.1: The crack in the fabric of the dreamworld is a window into Lucid's subconscious mind... But the crack appears too unstable to safely approach. You should gather #i4034983:# #b#t4034983:##k from the monsters around Lachelein first to stabilize the rift.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered #i4034983:# #b#t4034983:##k and stabilized the rift. Now you can safely peer inside.
